data.title: apps/invoicing: add-client on the invoice and contract screens answers a malformed email with a bare text/plain 400 instead of the specified validation state (S4/S6-CLIENT-ERROR-VALIDATION)

data.to:
Filed by the orchestrator at the AS-67 merge under the triage gate (cto-owen, 2026-09-12, tick watcher:79108 loop tick 15) from Ruben's AS-67 review finding 1 — a behaviour defect in shipped code, observed in the image, not argued.

THE DEFECT. On the invoice form (screen 4, AS-46) POST with intent=add-client and clientEmail 'not-an-email' — or a valid address with a leading or trailing space — returns a bare text/plain 400 ('ValidationError: screen-create') and drops the half-filled invoice form; 0 rows written. The same shape exists on the contract create screen (screen 6, AS-127): routes/contracts.js add-client calls repos.clients.create outside a try in the identical way. docs/design/wireframes/00-flows.md Flow 3 step 3a and the states ledger specify S4-CLIENT-ERROR-VALIDATION / S6-CLIENT-ERROR-VALIDATION for exactly this input, and neither screen renders it.

WHY NOW. Before AS-67 a malformed client email was accepted and refused at Stripe finalize as a 502; AS-67 moved the refusal to the repository (strictly better) and its plan scoped the screen rendering out (D6/§7). This task is the screen half: the screen renders the repository's refusal. It adds no second email check at a route — AS-67 D6 stands; the repository stays the one place the rule lives.

FIX SHAPE (Ruben's, for the planner rather than binding): trim clientEmail at both screens before calling the repository (the sign-up path already trims); catch the repository's ValidationError in the add-client branch the way the save branch already does (the clientRefused path), and render the validation state with the form values preserved. One task for both screens, so the two add-client branches stay identical.

ACCEPTANCE: on both screens a malformed clientEmail re-renders the form (HTML, 400 or the screen's existing validation status) with the typed values kept and the validation message shown, 0 rows written; a trailing-space email is accepted after trimming; the existing L4 row in test/clients.test.js proving the /clients route inherits the repository 400 is unchanged; a falsification recipe per M4 shows each screen's new case red once; no change to lib/db/; no new dependencies. Reviewer should not be Ruben (he named the fix).

provenance.reason: complexity low: two-stage path, Marcus plans and implements in one stage; Priya reviews (record excludes Ruben)

data.body:
Implemented (two-stage path), tip cf0a02a on feat/AS-128-add-client-validation-state, 7 files +224/-13.

WHAT CHANGED. Both add-client branches (routes/invoices.js, routes/contracts.js), identical in shape: after the blankness check `const email = clientEmail.trim()` is what findByEmail and create receive; create sits in a try, and `ValidationError` with `field === 'email'` renders the existing S4/S6-CLIENT-ERROR-VALIDATION state (400, text/html) via `clientEmailRefused: true`; anything else rethrows to the old text/plain path. Both view models take `clientEmailRefused`, honoured only under add-client and only as boolean true; blank still wins (`This field is required.`), otherwise the email field carries screen 1's sentence `Enter a complete email address.`. No email rule at a route (AS-67 D6). lib/db/, test/clients.test.js (L4), package files untouched (criterion 6, diff empty). README: one AS-128 sentence beside the AS-127 passage.

TESTS. 6 new: per screen a malformed case (`not-an-email` and ` not an email ` — inner whitespace survives the trim), a trim case (padded address stored trimmed; padded re-cased match warns as the duplicate), a view-model unit case.

COUNTS. master 524/505/0/19 `Image asc-impl-as128-base-test Built`; branch 530/511/0/19 `Image asc-impl-as128-green-test Built` — exactly +6.

RED SETS (mutate.mjs applies in place asserting one occurrence at the intended site; restored; `git diff --exit-code` clean after each; every run `Image asc-impl-as128-m<n>-test Built`, leak check clean):
- M1 invoices bare create: 530/510/1 = {S4 malformed} exact.
- M2 invoices no trim: 530/510/1 = {S4 trim} exact.
- M3 contracts bare create: 530/510/1 = {S6 malformed} exact.
- M4 contracts no trim: 530/510/1 = {S6 trim} exact.
- M5 invoice view model ignores flag: 530/509/2 = {S4 malformed, S4 unit} exact.
- M6 contract view model ignores flag: 530/509/2 = {S6 malformed, S6 unit} exact.

NOTE. My first M1 was a malformed mutant (added a second create call instead of deleting the catch; 4 reds). The helper now replaces the try/catch and asserts the create-call count is unchanged; m1.log is the rerun.

Left undone: nothing in scope; the name is not trimmed (not asked). Logs: scratchpad/agent-developer-marcus/AS-128/.
